title: HDT Control\selection-profiles.yaml
description: The named sets of share folders a boot image, a driver step and standalone media point at - MDT's selection profile, in the format the rest of HDT is authored in. The console, editors and CI validate against this; Assert-HDTSelectionProfileDocument is the gate that runs in WinPE, where Test-Json does not exist.

profiles.description: Every profile the share declares. The built-ins - all-drivers, everything, nothing - are answered by the engine and are never written here.

id.description: What workspace.yaml and a sequence step name this profile by. The built-in ids are reserved; Assert-HDTSelectionProfileDocument refuses one that shadows them, which draft-07 cannot express and which is listed as a blind spot in the schema's contract test.

name.description: What the console's picker shows. The id is what documents reference.

include.description: Share-relative folders, each meaning that folder and everything under it. An empty list is legal and is what MDT's Nothing profile is.

includePath.description: A path RELATIVE to the share whose first segment is a content folder. The boot image build hands what this names to Add-WindowsDriver with -Recurse, so a rooted path or a '..' segment would project whatever it reaches into a WIM transferred to every machine that PXE boots. The pattern refuses a drive, a UNC path, a leading separator and any '..' segment.
